verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a flexible, schema-less profile API (custom properties) and event tracking, plus rate-limit headers and error handling designed for production-scale API usage, and API key/OAuth scoping for secure automation. However, no explicit endpoint documentation for contact suppression or bulk profile update was cited, so the full contact lifecycle (create/update/suppress) isn't directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit suppression/unsubscribe endpoint docs, explicit profile update/create endpoint reference, and independent/hands-on verification of scale performance.
